datasets.verbatim: The coseismic landslide map was initially created by Hu et al. [39] and describes a series of mountain landslides triggered by the Mw 6.4 earthquake.

methods.name: SAR pixel-attention UNet (SPAUNet)
methods.summary: A deep learning model based on the UNet architecture that incorporates a pixel-attention mechanism to process pre- and post-event SAR amplitude images. It uses convolutional and activation layers to calculate pixel-attention weights, which are applied to feature maps to enhance the representation of critical landslide regions.
methods.verbatim: This research introduces a new method named synthetic aperture radar (SAR) pixel-attention UNet (SPAUNet) to address the challenges of noise and information redundancy when utilizing SAR amplitude data for landslide detection.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is mentioned but not linked, and the custom code for the SPAUNet method is not available via any repository or persistent link.
